readme: Written by scripts/spike-dictation-latency.ts. Chrome's encoders on the Hetzner box, synthetic speech, Chrome's network throttle. See docs/plans/260912b-dictation-slow-on-weak-wifi.md.

transcribed.label: opus-webm-32k
transcribed.text: Add this to Spideryarn, please. The granularity zoom is fine, but the gist column should follow the block id, which here is spya-k3m9qt. Alimentiveness barely gets a mention, but phrenology as a whole rests on it. Spurzheim was more careful than Gall, and Elliotson was not careful at all. The Müller-Lyer illusion does not show what he thinks it shows here. Predictive processing is doing all the work, and pareidolia is a separate claim about computational functionalism. Corrigibility and the disposition dial are in tension. Anthropic wants Claude to be a transparent conscientious objector and also broadly safe, and sandbagging is the failure mode nobody has priced in.
